name: Cerâmica em Família Workshop
description: Get your hands dirty with this fun, hands-on ceramics workshop. It's a wonderful way for the family to get creative together and make a unique souvenir to take home.
longDescription:
The Cerâmica em Família Workshop at Oficina Matérica on October 25, 2026, offers an opportunity for families to engage with clay. This hands-on session focuses on the craft of ceramics, providing guidance for participants to shape and decorate their own pieces. The workshop is designed to introduce basic pottery techniques in a collaborative setting, allowing attendees to explore their artistic side and create tangible items.

Participants can expect a creative and engaging atmosphere during this family-oriented event. The workshop is structured to be accessible for various age groups, encouraging shared activity and artistic expression. Each family will work together to produce unique ceramic objects, which they can then take home as a memento of their time in Porto. The duration of the workshop allows for a focused yet relaxed creative process.

Admission to the workshop varies in price. Oficina Matérica is located in Porto, accessible via public transport. Specific details regarding booking and transport routes will be available closer to the event date. The event is categorized for families, indicating its suitability for children and adults participating together.
